steps.en: The latest mobile number is fetched from the government data service
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru diambil dari layanan data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The refresh is switched off in every environment, so the stored number is used instead.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan ini dimatikan di semua environment, jadi nomor yang tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each individual owner is identified once and their notices are combined into one SMS
steps.id: Tiap pemilik individu diidentifikasi sekali dan notice-nya digabung dalam satu SMS
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates are not combined, so one owner can still receive more than one SMS.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda tidak digabung, jadi satu pemilik bisa menerima lebih dari satu SMS.

steps.en: The SMS lists outstanding notices and mentions the 2nd letter
steps.id: SMS memuat notice yang masih outstanding dan menyebut surat ke-2
steps.why_en: The message text lives in the database, so it cannot be confirmed that it refers to the 2nd letter.
steps.why_id: Teks pesan ada di database, jadi tidak bisa dipastikan menyebut surat ke-2.

steps.en: The SMS reminder is sent to the individual owner in a batch
steps.id: SMS reminder dikirim ke pemilik individu dalam satu batch
steps.why_en: The reminder job and SMS sending are switched off in the production settings, so nothing is sent.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dan pengiriman SMS dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, jadi tidak ada yang terkirim.
